proposed_decisions: Glyph B: in sec:p15-imprecise-probability B = B(Sigma) is the gamble space; in sec:p15-w02b-p15-034-partition-updates B is a partition cell; in sec:p15-w02b-p15-034-evidence-models B is a subset of a finite space (focal set or conditioning event, as in def:p14-evidence-uncertainty-data). Each section declares its use.
Dempster conditioning is written Bel_m(.||B), Pl_m(.||B) with a double bar so it is never identified with the coherent conditional E(.|B).

\underline P_1, \mathcal M_{mg}, \mathcal M_{ei}, \mathcal M_{str}, p^-, p^+ are local to def:p15-w02b-p15-034-two-binary and its two theorems; \mathcal M_{str} is the finite case of the product set C of def:p17-mmeu-product.
s_m(g) in the annex proof of thm:p15-w02b-p15-034-belief-extension is local and distinct from the partition support S(g) of def:p15-w02b-p15-034-partition.
